description: Pattern-based prevention rules for BiteClub (Rust + Bevy 0.14) — regression detection from deep code review findings

rules.name: Rust: cfg target_arch wasm32 with empty function body
rules.message: cfg(target_arch = "wasm32") function has an empty body — WASM build silently no-ops. Add a real implementation or a todo!() with a tracking issue.
rules.suggestion: Implement the WASM path using web-sys / wasm-bindgen, or add todo!("tracking issue #XXX") to make the gap explicit.

rules.name: Rust: std::mem::forget on stream/resource handle
rules.message: std::mem::forget() leaks the resource for the entire process lifetime. Store the handle in a long-lived container instead.
rules.suggestion: Store the OutputStream in a Resource, lazy_static, or once_cell::sync::Lazy to keep it alive without leaking.

rules.name: Rust: Hand-rolled JSON serialization via string manipulation
rules.message: Hand-rolled JSON via string find()/split()/format! is fragile — key substring collisions and no escape handling. Use serde.
rules.suggestion: Add #[derive(serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)] to the struct and use serde_json::to_string / from_str.

rules.name: Rust: rand::thread_rng() in Bevy system hot path
rules.message: rand::thread_rng() in a Bevy system breaks determinism and adds per-call overhead. Use the game's GameRng resource.
rules.suggestion: Add ResMut<GameRng> as a system parameter and use game_rng.gen_range(...) or game_rng.random().

rules.name: Rust: Relative file paths for saves/config
rules.message: Relative file path for game save/config data — resolves against CWD, not install dir. Use an absolute path from dirs::data_dir().

rules.name: Rust: unwrap() in non-test Bevy code
rules.message: unwrap() can panic at runtime. Use expect() with a message or proper error propagation with ?.
rules.suggestion: Use .expect("descriptive message") or propagate the error with ?.

rules.name: Rust: Config value drift from README
rules.message: Config constant defined in source — verify README and docs match this value. Run doc-sync check in CI.
rules.suggestion: Add a CI step that greps README.md for the same constant name and compares values.

rules.name: Rust: panic!() or unwrap_or_else(panic!) in non-test code
rules.message: panic!() in production code crashes the game. Use graceful error recovery or Result propagation.
rules.suggestion: Return Result<T, E> and handle errors gracefully, or use expect() with a clear message for truly impossible states.
